title: Post
description: A single social post bound to one tracked market, after ingestion and filtering. Produced by augury-ingest (Rust), consumed by the stance pipeline (Python). Rejected posts are emitted too, carrying a non-'accepted' filter_verdict, so the filter's precision stays auditable.

post_id.description: Platform-native post id. Unique per post but NOT unique in this stream: one post relevant to two tracked markets is emitted once per market.

created_at.description: When the post was published. This is the timestamp used for time-decay and for lead-lag alignment — never ingested_at.

ingested_at.description: When Augury read the post. Difference from created_at is the ingestion lag metric.

author_created_at.description: Author account creation time. Input to the account-age bot heuristic.

engagements.description: Likes + reposts + replies + quotes, summed. Feeds the S(t) weight w = ln(1+followers) * (1+engagements).

minhash.description: MinHash signature over the post's shingles, for near-duplicate detection.

lsh_bucket.description: LSH band bucket the signature hashed into; posts sharing a bucket are duplicate candidates.

source.description: 'fixture' means replayed test data, not a paid live read. Anything derived from fixture posts must never be reported as a real result.
